item.title: Overview of Ezekiel - Wheels of Glory, Bones of Hope, Rivers of Life
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # A man once climbed onto his roof to adjust a stubborn television aerial. It was one of those quiet afternoons when the sky is calm, the neighbourhood still, and the mind occupied with small tasks that feel harmless. But as he leaned forward to tighten a bolt, his foot slipped on a patch of dust, and suddenly the world tilted beneath him. He slid toward the gutter, scrambling for anything to hold. His hands caught the eaves trough, and there he hung, suspended between the familiar safety of the roof and the unknown distance below.
